verdict.rationale: Railway's own Railway Agent supports MCP connectors. Users can connect catalog servers such as Notion, Linear and Sentry, or point Railway at any remote MCP server, and the agent reads from it while working on projects. The evidence covers only remote servers and describes the agent reading from them, with one read-style example (pulling a Sentry issue or working from a Linear ticket), so full tool use is unproven. Missing for 10: support for local/stdio MCP servers, evidence that the agent can invoke write or action tools beyond reading, detailed configuration and auth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Connect Notion, Linear, or Sentry from the catalog, or point Railway at any remote MCP server you run, and the agent can read from it while it works on your projects.
Ask it why a deploy broke and it can pull the Sentry issue, or hand it a Linear ticket to work from.
The Railway Agent is a chat-based AI assistant built into the Railway dashboard.
